title: Years Later, the Childhood Dream Came True

meta.name: v5_y12_15_the-dream-comes-true
meta.title: Years Later, the Childhood Dream Came True

lines.text: Years later, the dream from his childhood came true.
His family comes to Egypt, and bows to him.
O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality.

quran.ar: یَـٰۤأَبَتِ هَـٰذَا تَأۡوِیلُ رُءۡیَـٰیَ مِن قَبۡلُ قَدۡ جَعَلَهَا رَبِّی حَقࣰّ اۖ

lines.text: Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.

quran.ar: رَبِّ قَدۡ ءَاتَیۡتَنِی مِنَ ٱلۡمُلۡكِ وَعَلَّمۡتَنِی مِن تَأۡوِیلِ ٱلۡأَحَادِیثِۚ فَاطِرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَ ٰ⁠تِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَنتَ وَلِیِّۦ فِی ٱلدُّنۡیَا وَٱلۡـَٔاخِرَةِۖ تَوَفَّنِی مُسۡلِمࣰا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِی بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِینَ

lines.text: He gave the credit to his Lord.
And at the top, he asked for a good ending.
